messages.subject: Login compatibility
messages.body:
The new resolver converts legacy compatibility forms before directory lookup. The gateway still checks reserved names after canonical normalization, before the alias reaches the resolver.

I saved the last maintenance capture at /notes/maintenance-frame.txt for your review. The alias didn’t survive the capture. The decoder’s character count, the frame reader’s UTF-16 length and the transport’s byte capacity did.

- Rowan

messages.subject: RE: Login compatibility
messages.body:
The change request moved to the next maintenance window. The reason I was given is that nobody has reported a successful unauthorized login.

Keep the capture. We’ll need those field lengths when we review the change.

— Mara
